errors.evidence: The y-axis is labeled "Стойности на EGDI" (Values of EGDI) and displays decimal values (e.g., 0.5000, 0.5500), not percentages. There is no '%' symbol present.
This is not the range of the y-axis. The y-axis range displayed on the chart is from 0.5000 to 0.9500. The description incorrectly uses data point values from the series as the axis range.

errors.text_span: Първата линия, обозначена с червен цвят и пунктирана, показва EGDI на ЕС
errors.evidence: The line for the EU is blue and solid, not red and dashed. The description mistakenly describes the red dashed trendline instead of the actual data line for the EU.
The starting value for the EU line in 2012 is explicitly labeled as 0.7483. The value 0.7556 corresponds to the year 2016 for the EU.

errors.text_span: Втората линия, обозначена с червен цвят и червена линия, показва EGDI на България
errors.evidence: The line for Bulgaria (BG) is orange and solid, not red. The description again confuses the data line with the red dashed trendline.
The starting value for the Bulgaria (BG) line in 2012 is explicitly labeled as 0.6132. The value 0.6312 is not present on the chart.

The description completely fails to mention the actual data lines: the blue solid line for the EU and the orange solid line for Bulgaria. It only describes the red dashed trendlines, and does so inaccurately.
The description omits a key visual feature of both data series: a noticeable dip in value in the year 2014. For BG, the value drops from 0.6132 to 0.5421, and for EU it drops from 0.7483 to 0.7300.
